ChatGPT affine W*x cache on those64 calls:26 full products+setup=2.37x work, slower CPU than direct, below frozen10x gate; not a trajectory certificate. next_discriminator.instructions: Choose ONE cheapest bounded next experiment likely to change the architecture decision. Rank based on information gain and clear falsifier, not correctness of an untested algorithm.

criteria.incremental_error: For one existing real RHS trace, compute per-receptor omission debt and scatter cost for CSC updates; reject if bound and update work remain too large.
criteria.coupled_mri: Implement one event-cut coupled multirate collocation prototype with continuous residual on a short real-operator interval; compare full products, accepted state and wall against strict parent.
criteria.krylov_jvp: Measure matrix-free JVP spectral/stiffness structure and event-version invalidation on a frozen real state, then trial exponential/Krylov only if few basis vectors meet residual.
